articles.title: TransDigm Announces Acquisition of Prince & Izant

articles.summary: CLEVELAND, July 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- TransDigm Group Incorporated (NYSE: TDG) today said it will report fiscal 2026 third quarter earnings before the market opens on Tuesday, August 4, 2026. A conference call will follow at 11:00 a.m., Eastern Time.
articles.title: TransDigm Third Quarter Earnings Report and Conference Call Set for Tuesday, August 4, 2026
